mainEntity.name: What's the safest way to get around Varanasi as a foreigner?

acceptedAnswer.text: Private pre-booked taxi service (like KashiTaxi) or hotel-arranged transport are the safest options. Avoid auto-rickshaws for solo travel.

mainEntity.name: How much should a taxi cost from Taj Ganges Hotel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hotel to Airport: ₹1,100-1,300. Hotel to Kashi Vishwanath: ₹200-300. Hotel to Sarnath: ₹1,500-1,800. Hourly rate: ₹400-500/hr.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Uber or Ola from Taj Ganges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes. Service availability varies by time of day with potential surge pricing (₹1500-2000). Pre-booking private taxi at fixed rate is better.

mainEntity.name: Should I book transport before arriving at the hotel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Pre-booking ensures fixed pricing, driver waiting with name board, WhatsApp updates, and no negotiation stress.

mainEntity.name: What are the must-see spots from Taj Ganges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within walking distance: Assi Ghat, Tulsi Ghat. Short taxi trips: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Manikarnika Ghat, Dashaswamedh Ghat. Day trips: Sarnath, Bodhgaya.

mainEntity.name: What's the best time for ghat tours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sunrise (5-7 AM) is best for peaceful, spiritual experience. Sunset (4-6 PM) with Ganga Aarti is also excellent. Avoid 12-4 PM due to crowds and heat.

mainEntity.name: How long do ghat tours actually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sunrise Ghat Walk: 60-90 minutes. Sunset + Ganga Aarti: 60-90 minutes. Complete Ghat System (full-day): 7-8 hours.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book tours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airport transfer: 2 days before. Sunrise ghat tour: 1 day before. Sightseeing tours: 3-5 days in advance. Special requests: 1 week in advance.

mainEntity.name: Are drivers and guides reliable and trustworthy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with proper booking. Our drivers have 5+ years experience, background verification, regular reviews, insurance coverage, and emergency protocol training.

mainEntity.name: What if I need transport at odd hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: 24-hour service is available. Early morning (2-6 AM) and late evening (10 PM-12 AM) trips are at standard rates with no night premium.
